subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed before mutating-tool handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: The requested behavior would change user-visible warning delivery and contradicts existing tests, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent warning policy.

options.title: Confirm Suppress-All And Rework
options.body: Adopt the issue’s suppress-all policy, move exec-like suppression ahead of mutating handling, and update focused tests for cron, heartbeat, full verbose, and mutating exec paths.

options.title: Preserve Detail Modes
options.body: Keep detail-mode warning paths visible, narrow or close the linked issue’s expected behavior, and avoid merging this partial suppress-all branch.

options.title: Accept Partial Suppression
options.body: Merge the current partial change knowing mutating exec-like failures can still warn and the issue may remain only partly fixed.

recommendation.title: Confirm Suppress-All And Rework
recommendation.body: Adopt the issue’s suppress-all policy, move exec-like suppression ahead of mutating handling, and update focused tests for cron, heartbeat, full verbose, and mutating exec paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest helper-history and adjacent runtime-maintenance signal for choosing the durable warning-policy boundary.
